column1: # survey: 2024 North Dakota Custom Rates, Part I Early Season Operations (August 2024) and Part II Late Season Operations (December 2024)
# publisher: North Dakota State University Extension (late season survey run by USDA NASS)
# collected: Early season: about 1,420 reports, July and August 2024. Late season: about 1,370 reports, October and November 2024.
# includes: The rates include charges for equipment, power, fuel, and the operator. Exchange work is not custom work for this survey. NDSU advises care with rates from fewer than fifteen reports.
# range_note: The range is the lowest and highest rate reported. Operations NDSU withheld (D) are left out. The early season file NDSU links is named as a draft.
